source.title: Infinite Dust — firsthand Frostwoven Belt report
source.author: Wowhead commenter 854192

rows.quote: i made 7 belts and i got 21 dust
rows.notes: Independent firsthand historical tailored Frostwoven Belt 41522 (WotLK) report: author says she/he made seven belts, disenchanted the crafted belts, and received 21 Infinite Dust. The comment also claims 'every one gives you at least 3 dust'; report text is not an operation-by-operation log. Seven positive outcomes are directly supported by 'every one'; no full 0..N stack histogram or other material distribution is recorded, and exact historical build, profession skill and current Retail eligibility are unknown. Different author and cohort from prior six-belt report 41522-244234; do not deduplicate them together.
